page.title: Budget
page.intro: What your agents cost, the prices you pay, and the caps that stop them. Prices come only from your table: a model without a price is never guessed.

spend.title: Spending
spend.unpriced: {{count}} runs have no price yet and are not counted.

prices.title: Price table
prices.intro: Per million tokens, in one currency per model. Models your agents used appear here; set a price to count them.
prices.empty: No models yet. They appear after an agent's first reply.

caps.title: Caps
caps.intro: When a cap is reached the agent stops cleanly, new work waits, and routines skip. Only you can raise a cap.
caps.uncovered: Not counted toward any cap until it has a price in the caps' currency: {{models}}.
caps.oneCurrency: Caps and prices must all use one currency. Change them to the same currency first.

card.stopped: {{name}} stopped. What it wrote so far is kept.
card.held: New work waits until the cap resets or you raise it.
card.ask: Raise the cap or keep it?
card.failed: That did not work. Only the owner can change a cap.

bundle.title: Move an agent (encrypted)
bundle.intro: One file with the agent's settings, memory, workspace, skills and chats, locked with a passphrase. Importing always makes a new agent.
bundle.passphraseHint: At least 8 characters. Without it the file cannot be opened.
bundle.vaultHint: Off by default. Needs your password again.

error.bad_passphrase_or_tampered: Wrong passphrase, or the file was changed. Nothing was imported.
error.unsafe_path: The file has unsafe paths. Nothing was imported.
error.unsupported_version: This file was made by a newer PasaBot. Nothing was imported.
error.not_a_bundle: This is not a PasaBot agent file.
error.reauth_required: Your password is needed to include vault entries.
error.builtin_agent: Your team builder is part of PasaBot, so it is not saved to a file. Your other agents can be.

server.capStopped: {{name}} stopped; what it wrote so far is kept.
server.capHeld: New work waits until the cap resets or you raise it.

page.intro: What your helpers cost, the prices you pay, and the limits that stop them. Prices come only from your table: a brain without a price is never guessed.

prices.intro: Copy the price from the brain's own price page: what it charges per 1 million pieces of text, e.g. 3 for input and 15 for output. One currency per brain version. Versions your helpers used appear here; set a price to count them.
prices.empty: Nothing yet. They appear after a helper’s first reply.

caps.intro: When a limit is reached the helper stops cleanly, new work waits, and routines skip. Only you can raise a limit.
caps.uncovered: Not counted toward any limit until it has a price in the limits’ currency: {{models}}.

bundle.title: Move a helper (locked file)
bundle.intro: One file with the helper’s settings, memory, files, abilities and chats, locked with a passphrase. Bringing it in always makes a new helper.
bundle.import: Bring in as a new helper

error.not_a_bundle: This is not a PasaBot helper file.
error.reauth_required: Your password is needed to include saved secrets.
error.builtin_agent: Your team builder is part of PasaBot, so it is not saved to a file. Your other helpers can be.
